items.headline: Alberta non-residential building cost indexes rose in 2026 Q2
items.observed_change: The non-residential building composite rose from 110.1 to 111.9 in Calgary and from 111.5 to 113.1 in Edmonton between 2026 Q1 and Q2 (2023=100). These are approximately 1.6% and 1.4% quarter-over-quarter increases, respectively; the series is not seasonally adjusted and can be revised.
items.model_implication: Update the Alberta construction-cost baseline after validating component-level movements. Do not attribute the change to AI investment; it is a pre-scenario market observation.

items.headline: AESO's 2026 outlook design treats data-centre growth as a major uncertainty
items.observed_change: AESO's 2026 Long-Term Outlook engagement material explicitly identifies increased data-centre development interest as a source of uncertainty for load growth and generation needs through 2050. The final outlook has not yet been published on this page.
items.model_implication: Keep multiple load-realization pathways and connection-stage probabilities in the Alberta power module rather than using a single data-centre load forecast.
